parts.when: [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), as an enemy unit targets one of your **KILLER** units.
parts.effect:
Whenever a **KILLER** model of the unit is **destroyed** while the unit has not yet been **selected to fight** in the phase, roll a D6:

- if it is a 1, the attacking enemy unit takes a [mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)
- if it is 2+, leave the model on the battlefield, and remove it once the unit has fought or as the phase ends, whichever is first
